gaps.sentence: ___ the storm passed did the ferries resume service.
gaps.explanation: Only after/once the storm passed did… — fronted 'only' phrase.

gaps.sentence: To ___ did you address that complaint, exactly?
Not until the following morning ___ the damage reported to the police.
gaps.explanation: 'Not until + time' triggers inversion: 'was the damage reported'.

gaps.sentence: Only when the last guest had left ___ she sit down.
gaps.explanation: 'Only when … had left did she sit down' — inverted past simple.

gaps.sentence: Seldom does a debut novel ___ so much critical attention.
gaps.explanation: 'Seldom does a novel receive …' — the auxiliary 'does' carries tense; base verb follows.

gaps.sentence: Not only ___ she apologise, she also paid for the damage.
gaps.explanation: Not only did she…, (but) she also… — inversion after not only.

gaps.sentence: Not only ___ the play cancelled, but the theatre was closed as well.
gaps.explanation: 'Not only was the play cancelled' — inverted passive.

gaps.sentence: So difficult ___ the exam that half the candidates failed.
gaps.explanation: So difficult was the exam that… — inversion for emphasis.
